issue.title: Add react docgen info into React classes with the react-docgen babel plugin

repository.name: storybook
repository.description: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation

issue.body:
Generates propType docs for all react components used in stories at runtime using [babel-plugin-react-docgen](https://github.com/kadirahq/babel-plugin-react-docgen). 
It also collects all the react propType docs to a global object named `STORYBOOK_REACT_CLASSES`.

body:
Yep. I can understand the issue.
I'll do a fix today.

I can't reproduce the issue with the above code. Plugin shouldn't inject any code at all here since `react-docgen` doesn't detect any react components. It returns an error and that error is handled internally by the plugin. 
Maybe a more comprehensive example would help.

issue.title: Hot fix for react-storybook/issues/580

repository.name: babel-plugin-react-docgen
repository.description: 📝 Babel plugin to add react-docgen info into your code.

issue.body:
This is a hack to fix storybook issue (https://github.com/kadirahq/react-storybook/issues/580). 
We should implement a way (a flag or something) so that user can choose not to load the plugin. And find the actual root cause of this bug.

body: Even with this code, neither the plugin nor react-docgen gives any output.
